dataset: EmoSynth: The Emotional Synthetic Audio Dataset
citation: Baird, A., Parada-Cabaleiro, E., Fraser, C., Hantke, S., and Schuller, B. (2018). The Perceived Emotion of Isolated Synthetic Audio: The EmoSynth Dataset and Results. Audio Mostly 2018.
count_note: The corrected 2020 archive contains 168 WAVs and 168 matching aggregate-label rows, while its landing-page description and 2018 paper describe 144 files. Use the inspected archive count, retain this discrepancy.
frequency_note: No Hz mapping is present in the archive. The paper maps 12 frequency classes; do not assign that table directly to the archive's 14 frequency indices. Derive frequency from waveform and label it as measured.

ratings.construct: perceived valence and arousal, not pain relief or comfort treatment response
ratings.per_stimulus_annotator_n: not provided; means suggest varying counts, so do not assume 40 for every clip
ratings.statistics: valence/arousal are aggregate means; rounded SD fields represent across-listener rating dispersion, not confidence intervals

clinical_validation: No migraine or pain outcomes measured in this dataset.
